messages.text: I’ll review the original-framework comparison’s numbers, provenance, seed handling and figure while the separate C/D analysis finishes.

A/B review at `554ca5e684b64db4f0648331b48770030868a07a` found no numerical or scientific blocker.

- A: 4,600 events, 2,357,083 matched cells, zero selection/energy mismatches; strict tolerance bounds verified.
- B: all four comparisons reconstructed exactly from ROOT/native outputs; declared gates and seed checks passed.
- Figure reproduced byte-identically and passed visual inspection.
- 416/417 artifact entries matched. The sole mismatch was the active controller log; correction source `02fdc9ad5423b75e80cc13b1669997d19b528c08` appropriately excludes it.

Replacement metadata still needs confirmation. These establish scoped software compatibility, not detector-performance acceptance. No repository files changed.

limitations: Only userMessage and agentMessage text retained; reasoning, tool arguments/results and private state excluded.
